chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the person in ihram, how does he scratch his head? He said: 'With his fingernails, as long as he does not cause bleeding or cut the hair.'

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: The person in the state of ihram (ritual consecration)

ai.seo_question: How should a person in ihram scratch their head without invalidating their ritual state?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the precise boundary of permissible grooming during ihram, distinguishing between mere scratching with nails and the prohibited acts of cutting hair or drawing blood. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on literal interpretation of the Prophet's instructions, ensuring pilgrims maintain ritual purity without incurring penalties for minor infractions.
